m-jacksonville|2025-06-16|266e56a5|02b1e.title: Chair Howland asked if members had been briefed on the $40 million JEA contribution bill. Council Member Boylan, the bill sponsor, confirmed discussions with JEA. Chair Howland expressed concern over limited briefings on such a major item and proposed deferral. Mr. Peterson stated deferral was not an issue if the bill passed within the fiscal year. Mike Weinstein countered that council must approve the contribution before July for it to be included in the proposed budget. Debate followed between Mr. Peterson and Mr. Weinstein over budget authority. Council Member Freeman expressed support for a deferral and emphasized the importance of the auditors’ input. Kurt Wilson, JEA, said their board had already approved the agreement and supported more outreach. Dr. Johnson questioned the need for formal council approval to include the contribution in the budget, to which Mr. Weinstein responded that authorization was required to balance the budget. Council Member Freeman added comments urging more civil discourse and clarified his bill involving $10M from JEA to UF Health was to backfill a previous budget gap. After discussion, consensus was reached to defer, with the option for the Council President to discharge the bill if other committees advance it.
